title: Cream Shearling Coat by the Woodpile
prompt: An original young woman sits in a wooden lounge chair beside a stacked woodpile and a weathered plank wall, with light snow on the ground. She wears a long, cream wool belted coat with a high funnel collar, a cream knit headband with star earrings, and cream knit gloves. A soft white fur throw drapes the chair. Her expression is calm and direct. Cool, overcast daylight. Palette of cream, weathered brown, and icy blue. Soft and elegant, in the style of a winter lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The cream coat and fur throw are the textures to highlight.
- Keep the woodpile and snow for a rustic winter setting.
